name: Voice Agent Core
objective: Build a modular and scalable voice-agent core that can later host independent business modules such as Dental, HVAC and ITP without coupling those domains to the core.
rules: The Voice Core must remain domain-agnostic.
Business-domain modules are plugins or adapters, not core dependencies.
Public contracts must be explicit and versionable.
Security and observability are first-class requirements.
Do not claim tests passed unless they were actually executed.
acceptance_criteria: Architecture separates telephony, audio, speech and intelligence concerns.
Failure, timeout and retry behavior is explicitly defined.
Components can be replaced through interfaces or adapters.
Dental, HVAC and ITP modules can be added without changing the core contract.
